author: (Gmelin, 1791)
evidence: GBIF: 1 record in the region, an INBio specimen from the shore near Puerto Vargas, Cahuita (2001)
Listed as Lucina (Phacoides) pectinata by Robinson & Montoya 1987 and as Phacoides pectinatus by Espinosa & Ortea 2001

about.en: The thick lucine is a heavy, rounded clam of muddy sand, mangrove edges and sheltered shallows, where it lives buried in sulphide-rich mud. Like other lucines it relies on bacteria in its gills for a large share of its food. Locally it was recorded at the shore near Puerto Vargas in Cahuita. It is a clam you are most likely to meet as an empty shell on a muddy shore.
about.es: La lucina gruesa es una almeja pesada y redondeada de arena fangosa, bordes de manglar y aguas someras protegidas, donde vive enterrada en fango rico en sulfuro. Como otras lucinas, depende de bacterias en las branquias para buena parte de su alimento. Localmente se registró en la orilla cerca de Puerto Vargas, en Cahuita. Es una almeja que lo más probable es encontrar como concha vacía en una orilla fangosa.

idTips.en: Thick, rounded, whitish shell with many fine raised concentric ridges. Only found in muddy shallows.
idTips.es: Concha gruesa, redondeada y blanquecina con muchas crestas concéntricas finas y elevadas. Solo se halla en aguas someras fangosas.

diet.en: Gills hold sulphur-oxidising bacteria that make part of its food; it also takes in some particles from the water.
diet.es: Sus branquias albergan bacterias que oxidan azufre y aportan parte de su alimento; también toma algunas partículas del agua.

predators.en: Crabs, shell-crushing fish, rays, moon snails and octopus.
predators.es: Cangrejos, peces que rompen conchas, rayas, caracoles luna y pulpos.

behaviour.en: Buried in mud; does not react to people.
behaviour.es: Enterrada en fango; no reacciona a las personas.

where.en: Muddy shallows and mangrove edges; the only local record is near Puerto Vargas, Cahuita.
where.es: Aguas someras fangosas y bordes de manglar; el único registro local es cerca de Puerto Vargas, Cahuita.

edibleNote.en: Thick-shelled and from muddy, often polluted shallows; not a food here.
edibleNote.es: De concha gruesa y de aguas someras fangosas, a menudo contaminadas; no es alimento aquí.
